note: Converted from the ten Explorer spots in data/explore/cities/istanbul.ts through docs/world/research/explorer-pins.json, plus three museums and four more places. Q-ids with an ok/check verdict in the audit were reused; the two marked wrong and the two unmatched were re-chosen by hand, searching Wikidata in Turkish and reading the description. The brief's two museum ids were not museums at all: Q1193013 is a Japanese girl group and Q1444226 a 1990 video game, so both were re-searched (İstanbul Arkeoloji Müzeleri → Q636978, Rahmi M. Koç Müzesi → Q3404565). No entrance is claimed anywhere: nobody has measured a door in this city yet, so every pin is a centroid or an area, honestly labelled, and the doors that the venues describe in words go into location.findIt instead.

places.name: Hippodrome of Constantinople (Sultanahmet Square)
places.note: Audit verdict 'check' (66 m from the Explorer pin, which sat by the obelisk). The square is 450 m long, so an area pin is the honest anchor.

places.name: Hagia Sophia
places.note: Audit verdict 'check' (84 m): the Explorer pin was on the visitor side, Wikidata's point is the building's centre. The centroid of a building this size is the right thing to store; the visitor door goes into findIt.

places.name: Topkapı Palace
places.note: Q170495 is the palace itself (an instance of palace and museum). Q64682290, the museum institution, carries no coordinate at all — the classic institution trap.

places.name: Istanbul Archaeology Museums
places.note: Q636978 is typed as a museum building as well as a museum, and its point sits on the main building. Q136402588 ('Main Building of the Istanbul Archaeological Museums') is 15 m away but has no OSM or Wikipedia link, so it could only ever grade C; the better-linked item is kept.

places.name: Gülhane Park
places.note: Audit verdict 'check' (79 m): a 9.7-hectare park, so its centre is legitimately far from the gate.

places.name: Grand Bazaar
places.note: Audit verdict 'wrong' (190 m), but the item is right: the Explorer pin stood at the Nuruosmaniye gate and Wikidata's point is the middle of 61 covered streets. Stored as an area, with the gate described in findIt.

places.name: Çiçek Pasajı (Flower Passage), İstiklal Avenue
places.note: Replaces İstiklal Avenue (Q344348), which the audit marked 'wrong': a 1.4 km avenue has a centroid 205 m from anywhere a child stands. The Flower Passage is the building the Explorer story is actually about, and it sits on Galatasaray Square where the Explorer pin was.

places.name: Patriarchal Church of St George, Fener
places.note: The audit left this spot unmatched. Q211004 is the Ecumenical Patriarchate as an institution; Q1346546 is the cathedral building it sits in, found through its enwiki title after searches in Greek and Turkish returned nothing.

places.name: Maiden's Tower (Kız Kulesi)
places.note: An islet 200 m off the Üsküdar shore; the pin is the tower, the boats leave from the shore, and findIt says so.
